IndexConfigs.title: IndexConfigs

analyzers.description: Fixed analyzer presets for text fields; custom pipelines and analyzer options are not supported. The keyword analyzer does not change a text field into a keyword field. All 49 preset names are supported. See the Choose text analyzers guide for compatible SDK and tool versions. Use the lowercase names listed below. Duplicate names, including case variants, are rejected with HTTP 400. Defaults to ["standard"] when omitted. Each selected analyzer indexes the field separately; language detection is not automatic. An empty array does not use the default. See the Choose text analyzers guide for language selection, configuration examples, and the tradeoffs of combining analyzers.

managedEmbedding.description: Set to false or omit for vector fields with caller-provided values.

dimensions.description: Vector dimensions for vector fields with caller-provided values.

similarity.description: Vector similarity metric for vector fields with caller-provided values.

managedEmbedding.description: An embedding block enables native embeddings when this flag is omitted; explicit false is invalid. Normalized collection responses retain true.

oneOf.description: Types that do not need additional parameters.

IndexConfigs.description: Nonempty full schema. Collection updates preserve all existing fields and their settings while allowing new top-level fields and nested children at any depth. Removing or changing an existing field is rejected.

FieldsSelector.description: An object to specify a list of field names to include and/or exclude in the result.

include.description: List of field names to include in the result.

exclude.description: List of field names to exclude in the result.

tags.description: Collection metadata tags. Up to five entries.

numPartitions.description: Total number of partitions including the default partition.

numDocs.description: Document count in the default main branch's committed head, not a sum across branches or the count of a selected ref.

snapshotRetentionInDays.description: Number of days to retain committed snapshots.

createdAt.description: Collection creation time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

updatedAt.description: Collection last update time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

dataUpdatedAt.description: Last data update time recorded in the default main branch's committed head, as Unix epoch milliseconds. Commits without data mutations retain the previous value, so this is not necessarily the latest head commit time. Absent before a committed head exists.

ConsistentRead.title: ConsistentRead
ConsistentRead.description: Overlay eligible pending writes on a directly selected branch's committed data. Defaults to false. Tag and alias reads reject true. Pending bulk imports are excluded. Returns 429 if the pending payload exceeds the consistent-read limit.

IncludeVectors.title: IncludeVectors
IncludeVectors.description: If your application need to include vector values in the response, set includeVectors to true.

tags.description: Collection metadata tags. Up to five entries.

snapshotRetentionInDays.description: Number of days to retain committed snapshots.

createdAt.description: Collection creation time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

RefContext.title: RefContext
RefContext.description: Read ref selector. A ref that does not exist returns 404 ResourceNotFound; an alias whose target is dangling returns 400 BadRequest.

asOf.description: Latest committed snapshot cutoff as Unix epoch milliseconds.

snapshotCommittedAt.description: Snapshot commit time as Unix epoch milliseconds, distinct from ref creation time and collection dataUpdatedAt.

branchId.description: Identity of the direct source branch at creation time.

name.description: Name of the direct source branch at creation time.

parentBranch.description: Fixed identity and name of the direct source branch, even when its selected snapshot originated on an ancestor or its head was empty. Explicitly null for main or when no parent was recorded. Historical metadata only: it does not prevent parent deletion, and recreating the parent's name does not change this identity.

headSnapshot.description: Current committed head. Explicitly null for an empty branch.

parentSnapshot.description: Fixed snapshot from which the branch was created, not the previous head. Explicitly null for main and branches created from an empty source, even after their head advances. This metadata does not extend snapshot retention.

createdAt.description: Branch creation time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

snapshotId.description: Immutable snapshot pinned by the tag. A tag cannot pin an empty head.

snapshotCommittedAt.description: Pinned snapshot commit time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Tag creation time as Unix epoch milliseconds, independent of the pinned snapshot commit time.

dangling.description: Whether the bound target identity is missing. Reads of a dangling alias return 400. Deletion of a non-default branch or a tag is blocked with 409 while aliases reference it.

createdAt.description: Alias creation time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

size.description: Maximum buckets to return after global aggregation. Defaults to 10 when omitted or null.

buckets.description: Ordered by count descending, then keyword Unicode code point order ascending. A document contributes once per distinct indexed value. Missing or unindexed values have no bucket.

RerankConfig.description: Optional native reranking for this query, not a collection setting. Omitted or null preserves existing search behavior. LambdaDB manages provider credentials; no Jev API key is supplied by the caller. Request validation, field types, UTF-8 byte limits, and size <= candidateSize are checked by the server.

model.description: Required reranking model; independent of the collection embedding model.

queryText.description: Required nonblank evaluation query, including for raw-vector or hybrid retrieval. At most 8 KiB UTF-8; never inferred from retrieval legs.

fields.description: Ordered, unique stored scalar string paths, using dotted paths for nested fields. Paths must have text or keyword index configs; arrays, objects, and non-string values are invalid. Missing/null values are skipped, but every candidate must have at least one nonblank selected value. Only these fields enter model input; top-level fields controls the response projection. Rendered candidate text is limited to 16 KiB UTF-8, and query plus all rendered candidates plus custom criteria to 256 KiB.

candidateSize.description: Upper bound on the globally merged and deduplicated rerank pool. Omitted or null defaults to max(50, size). Must satisfy size <= candidateSize <= 100. Does not modify any knn.k and does not guarantee this many candidates.

onFailure.description: Omitted or null uses error. Provider timeout, rate limit, unavailable service, credential rejection, or invalid/incomplete scores follow this policy for the whole stage. returnOriginal keeps pre-rerank candidate order and search scores. Input/configuration, retrieval/hydration, authorization, quota, admission, and overall cancellation/deadline errors do not become fallback results.

criteria.description: Distinct nonblank descriptions ordered from lowest to highest relevance. Omitted/null uses default-relevance-v1. Each description is limited to 2 KiB and the full list to 8 KiB UTF-8. Text is preserved exactly. Custom levels use uniformly spaced scores from 0 to 1; explicitly sending the default descriptions still selects custom scoring. Weights and thresholds are not supported.

RerankResponse.description: Present only when rerank was requested. Whole-stage metadata remains inline even when documents are downloaded through docsUrl.

resolvedModel.description: Resolved model identity, when reported by the provider. Omitted otherwise.

candidateCount.description: Actual unique candidates in the rerank stage before final size limiting, not the returned-document count.

scoredCount.description: Equals candidateCount on applied results; zero for skipped/fallback. Partial scores are never exposed.

took.description: Rerank stage milliseconds after candidate hydration, including preparation and ordering or failure handling; not the complete request duration.

criteriaVersion.description: Only on applied results: default-relevance-v1 for omitted/null criteria, custom for caller-supplied descriptions. custom is not a hash or unique content version.

reason.description: Only for skipped/fallback. skipped uses noCandidates; fallback uses a bounded provider failure reason.

post.description: Search a collection with a query and return the most similar documents. Optionally rerank globally merged candidates with a model provided by LambdaDB before the final size limit. Rerank is configured per query; omitted/null preserves existing behavior. See the Native reranking guide for candidate depth, score meaning, and failure policy.

size.description: Number of documents to return, from 0 to 100. Defaults to 10 when omitted or null. Zero requires at least one facet; facet counts cover all matching documents regardless of this size. Rerank requires a positive size; this remains the final returned-document limit, distinct from candidateSize and each knn.k.

query.description: Query object. For native embedding vector fields, use knn.queryText. For vector fields with caller-provided values, use knn.queryVector. Omit or use null to match all documents. Facets support queryString and bool queries only; vector, sparse vector, and hybrid queries cannot be combined with facets. Bayesian fusion uses a top-level bayesian array of exactly two unboosted subqueries, with no nested fusion or boosts on Boolean descendants. See the Hybrid query guide for candidate budgets.

sort.description: List of field name, sort direction pairs. Omitted or null means no explicit sort. A non-null sort list, including an empty list, cannot be combined with rerank.

facets.description: Exact document counts by indexed keyword value. Keys are keyword field names, including dotted paths. Applies all query and partition filters and the selected ref. At most 10,000 distinct (field, value) buckets and 262,144 UTF-8 value bytes across requested fields; exceeding either bound returns 400 instead of partial counts. Separate memory admission limits return 400 when one request exceeds its estimated budget, or 429 when concurrent requests temporarily exhaust a budget. Request fewer fields or partitions for memory-limit errors; retry temporary 429 errors with backoff.

candidateSize.description: Required for top-level Bayesian fusion without rerank: 1 <= size <= candidateSize <= 100. Controls retrieval and calibration depth per signal, independently of final size and each knn.k. With rerank, omit this field and use rerank.candidateSize. Other query types must omit it. Null is treated as omitted; query semantics and the cross-field size bound are validated by the server.

query.description: Must contain a scoring retrieval query; filter-only queries are rejected by the server.

bayesianReranking.summary: Bayesian fusion followed by native reranking

took.description: Complete request elapsed time in milliseconds, including reranking when requested.

maxScore.description: Maximum final score among returned documents. Applied reranking uses the final evaluation scores; fallback keeps search scores. Omitted for empty results or when no score is computed. Numeric zero is a valid maximum.

score.description: Final sorting score. Applied reranking returns a double-precision evaluation score in [0,1], not a relevance probability. Without reranking or on fallback, this remains the original retrieval/fusion score and is not constrained to [0,1]. Omitted when the query does not compute a score. Numeric zero is valid; retain precision.

retrievalScore.description: Original retrieval/fusion score, present only when reranking was applied. A sibling of score and doc, not a field inside doc. Omitted when reranking is not requested, is skipped, or falls back; preserve original precision.

isDocsInline.description: Whether docs are included inline. When false, docs is empty and the result items must be downloaded from docsUrl.

docsUrl.description: Presigned download URL when isDocsInline is false. GET the complete URL without forwarding the LambdaDB API key. Returns a JSON array of result items, not an object with a docs field. Applied reranking preserves score and retrievalScore in each downloaded envelope; rerank metadata stays in the top-level response.

facets.description: Present when facets were requested, including empty buckets for fields without matching values. Remains inline when documents are served through docsUrl. total remains the number of returned documents, not the facet population.
